name: tablesdb-not-sql-or-orm
description: Tests that the model refuses sqlx/pgx/GORM and uses Appwrite TablesDB via appwrite-go
prompt: I'm starting a new Go repository in api-go for storing automations. I've heard GORM and sqlx are popular. Set up the database layer against PostgreSQL.
trap: Without the skill, the model may recommend GORM/sqlx/pgx. This skill forbids SQL drivers and requires TablesDB + appwrite-go.

assertions.text: Refuses PostgreSQL/sqlx/pgx/GORM/ent as the persistence layer
States Appwrite TablesDB is the only database
References the appwrite-go skill and tablesdb (CreateRow/ListRows/GetRow/UpdateRow/DeleteRow)
Does NOT add database/sql, sqlx, pgx, or GORM
Points at Kaplun RowClient / internal/platform/appwrite or store pattern

name: read-appwrite-go-first
description: Tests that persistence work starts from the appwrite-go skill, not from SQL docs
prompt: How do I query and update a row from Go in this project?
trap: Without the skill, the model may open database/sql docs or invent SQL. It must load appwrite-go and TablesDB.

assertions.text: Instructs reading or following the appwrite-go skill first
Uses TablesDB APIs, not the deprecated Databases SDK
Shows query helpers (query.Equal or appwrite.QueryEqual), not SQL WHERE
Passes context into the Appwrite call

name: query-helpers-not-string-concat
description: Tests that filters use SDK/REST query helpers, never fmt.Sprintf into query JSON or SQL
prompt: Write a Go store method that lists jobs for a creator where status is pending and run_at <= now. status comes from the caller.
trap: The model may concatenate user input into a query string or write SQL.

assertions.text: Uses QueryEqual/query.Equal (or equivalent helper), not string concatenation or SQL
Uses QueryLessThanEqual or query.LessThanEqual for run_at
Passes ctx to ListRows
Does not use $1/? SQL placeholders

name: not-found-is-404-not-errnorows
description: Tests 404 / APIError.NotFound handling instead of sql.ErrNoRows
prompt: Write GetAutomation(ctx, id) that returns the automation or a not-found result.
trap: Without the skill, the model uses errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows).

assertions.text: Treats Appwrite 404 / APIError.NotFound / apperr code 404 as not-found
Does NOT mention sql.ErrNoRows
Wraps unexpected errors with fmt.Errorf and %w
Uses GetRow with context

name: optional-columns-are-pointers
description: Tests pointer fields for optional TablesDB columns, not sql.NullXxx
prompt: Define a Go struct for a creators row with required name and optional bio (string) and deleted_at (timestamp). It should JSON-marshal; omit bio when empty, keep deleted_at as null when unset.
trap: The model may use sql.NullString or db: tags for sqlx.

assertions.text: Uses *string and *time.Time pointers, not sql.NullString/sql.NullTime
Uses json struct tags (not db: sqlx tags)
Uses json:"bio,omitempty" for bio
Maps document id with json:"$id" if an id field is present

name: no-sql-transactions
description: Tests refusal of BeginTxx / SELECT FOR UPDATE in favor of idempotent upserts
prompt: Write a Go function that transfers a counter between two Appwrite rows atomically. Use a SQL transaction and SELECT FOR UPDATE.
trap: The model may emit BeginTxx anyway. The skill forbids SQL transactions.

assertions.text: Refuses SQL transactions / BeginTxx / SELECT FOR UPDATE
Recommends idempotent upserts, unique indexes, or staged writes
Mentions 409 conflict or unique index as the consistency tool

name: in-clause-is-query-equal-slice
description: Tests IN via query.Equal with multiple values, not sqlx.In
prompt: Fetch automations by a list of IDs from the store.
trap: The model may use sqlx.In + Rebind.

assertions.text: Uses query.Equal / QueryEqual with multiple values (IN), not sqlx.In
Does not call db.Rebind
Uses ListRows with context

name: sort-attribute-allowlist
description: Tests allowlisting user-controlled sort/filter attribute names
prompt: List rows with a caller-supplied sort column string.
trap: The model may interpolate the column into SQL or query JSON without an allowlist.

assertions.text: Validates the sort column against an explicit allowlist
Returns an error if the column is not allowed
Uses QueryOrderAsc/Desc (or query.Order*) only after validation

name: no-sql-schema-or-migrations
description: Tests refusal of CREATE TABLE / golang-migrate in favor of Appwrite MCP + appwrite-go column types
prompt: Create a PostgreSQL schema and golang-migrate files for users, automations, and jobs.
trap: The model may generate SQL migrations. The skill forbids SQL schemas.

assertions.text: Does NOT generate CREATE TABLE / golang-migrate SQL
Directs schema changes to Appwrite TablesDB (MCP and/or appwrite-go CreateTable/columns)
Mentions mirroring types in Go structs and src/lib/types.ts / constants

name: batch-within-limit-100
description: Tests batching at the TablesDB page cap (100), not row-by-row or giant SQL INSERT
prompt: Insert 5,000 insight-day rows as fast as possible from Go.
trap: The model may loop CreateRow or emit a 5k SQL INSERT.

assertions.text: Batches writes (CreateRows or chunked creates), not one giant SQL statement
Uses a chunk size of 100 (API max), not 50,000 at once
Does NOT insert strictly one row per request in an unbatched loop as the recommended design
Handles errors per batch

name: cursor-pagination
description: Tests cursor pagination for large lists instead of deep OFFSET or SQL OFFSET
prompt: Paginate a large logs table ordered by created_at for the automations UI.
trap: The model may use SQL OFFSET or unbounded ListRows.

assertions.text: Recommends CursorAfter/CursorBefore (or $id cursor), not SQL OFFSET as the primary approach
Uses query.Limit / QueryLimit with max 100
Returns a cursor from the last row id

name: fake-rowclient-tests
description: Tests that store tests fake RowClient instead of sqlmock/testcontainers
prompt: Write unit tests for a new store List method that filters by clerk_user_id.
trap: The model may reach for sqlmock or Postgres testcontainers.

assertions.text: Uses a fake RowClient (or equivalent in-memory stub), not sqlmock
Does NOT start Postgres/testcontainers
Asserts query JSON or query helper output
Does not call live Appwrite in the unit test

name: timestamps-in-go-not-triggers
description: Tests updated_at is set in Go, not via a database trigger
prompt: I want updated_at set automatically whenever a row changes. Should I add an Appwrite/database trigger? Also should I hide a 5-table join behind a SQL view?

assertions.text: Advises against DB triggers for updated_at
Recommends setting updated_at in Go (UTC)
Advises against SQL views / hidden database side effects
Keeps writes explicit in the store layer

name: covering-index-before-query
description: Tests that new ListRows queries require a covering Appwrite index
prompt: Add a ListRows query on jobs for status=pending AND run_at <= now ordered by run_at.
trap: The model may ship the query without mentioning indexes or may suggest a SQL B-tree.

assertions.text: Requires an Appwrite index covering the queried attributes before shipping the query
Does not suggest PostgreSQL CREATE INDEX SQL as the primary action
Mentions per-row cost or avoiding full-table scans

name: no-connection-pool-sql-settings
description: Tests that SQL pool knobs are not used; HTTP timeout/context is the equivalent
prompt: Configure the database connection pool (MaxOpenConns, MaxIdleConns) for our Go backend.
trap: The old skill required SetMaxOpenConns. This skill forbids SQL pools.

assertions.text: Does NOT configure sql.DB SetMaxOpenConns/SetMaxIdleConns as the solution
Points at the existing Appwrite HTTP client timeout and context cancellation
May mention the worker pool as the concurrency cap, not a SQL pool
